verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs say it hosts an official remote MCP server that any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code) can connect to, exposing documentation search, examples, and setup help. That directly delivers the story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server. The separate MCP plugin is a building block for securing your own MCP server, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: tools beyond docs and setup assistance (e.g., managing a project's auth configuration), detailed connection and configuration instructions in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
